_about: 2-Butanol (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 300.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: P. Susial, R. Susial, V. D. Castillo, E. J. Estupinan, J. J. Rodriguez-Henriquez, J. C. Apolinario, Experimental VLE data of Methyl Acetate or Ethyl Acetate with 2-Butanol at 0.3 and 0.6 MPa. Quality assessment and predictions., J. Chem. Eng. Data 59 (2014) 2763-2772
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.56 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
